lots.what_it_is: Mixed lot of small silver, catalogued as sterling: a repousse egg cup with gilt interior, a pair of repousse round salts with shell-bowl salt spoons, a novelty miniature of a man beside a barrel on a scroll-edged tray, a thimble, and a button hook with a repousse handle.
lots.key_photo_findings: One photo, all six pieces. Egg cup: heavily embossed flowers and scrolls, gilt-washed interior, plain spreading foot; no marks visible. Salts: thin repousse floral bowls with wavy rims, both slightly out of round with small dents at the rim; the spoons have ribbed shell bowls and ball finials. Miniature: cast figure and barrel on an embossed rectangular tray with scroll corners, typical of Dutch or continental silver toys; the figure looks darker, possibly brass coloured or tarnished, so it may not be silver. Thimble: dimpled crown with a band of marks on the lower rim, unreadable at this size. Button hook: steel shaft with a repousse filled handle (only the handle is silver). No hallmark can be read anywhere.
lots.condition: Salts dented and slightly misshapen. Egg cup looks sound. Others look fair to good. No weights given; the button hook handle and possibly the egg cup base are thin or filled.
